# #965 — aqmd in <repo> from a lane clone scopes on the clone, not the named repo, since the repo-local .qmd retirement (#960)

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-29T17:13:17Z
Updated: 2026-08-29T17:13:17Z

---

Found by the session-13 lanes (2026-08-29), twice.

## What happens

From a lane clone under `/Volumes/ThunderBolt/_tmp/open-brain/_worktrees/lane-N` (origin/main at 3a44eece or later, no `.qmd/` directory):

    timeout 60 aqmd in open-brain "test_database_required"
    aqmd: /Volumes/ThunderBolt/_tmp/open-brain/_worktrees/lane-5/.qmd/index.yml is empty -- the index would return nothing.
    aqmd: rebuild it:  DEV=/Volumes/ThunderBolt/_tmp/open-brain/_worktrees /Volumes/ThunderBolt/Development/_ob/bin/qmd-backfill

Head re-run from lane-5 reproduces it. A second lane saw `repo 'open-brain' has no .qmd/ index` for the same call.

## Why

`_ob/bin/aqmd` resolves scope from the cwd before it honours the `in <repo>` alias: the catalogue branch (`:750-757`) needs `${repo_root:h}/.qmd/index.yml`, and a clone's parent is `_worktrees/`, which has none; the walk-up (`:759-763`) stops at the clone boundary; the fallback then tries to build a private index for the clone (`:786-797`), which is the exact thing HANDOVER-RULES rule 51 exists to stop. The `in` form (`:1068`) never gets a chance to point at the root checkout's card in `/Volumes/ThunderBolt/Development/.qmd/index.yml:2879`.

Before #960 the clone carried a tracked `.qmd/index.yml`, so the walk-up found it and the design-lookup hook was satisfied (at the cost of a private index per clone, rule 51).

## Effect

Every lane brief names `aqmd in open-brain "<word>"` as the clone-side design lookup (`.claude/hooks/design-lookup-gate.ts` requires one before Write/Edit). Both session-13 write lanes proceeded without a lookup and read the design sources directly. Rule 51's prescribed clone lookup is currently unusable.

## Not done here

`_ob/bin/aqmd` is Development-owned; no change proposed in this repo. Whether `in <repo>` should resolve the named card from the catalogue regardless of cwd is Rico's call. Until then, lane briefs should name the Read-tool route the hook also accepts (`docs/decisions/*.md`).
